name: hcapp_updatePhotoCaption
description: Allows an authorised reviewer (Hash Flash 0x20, GM 0x02, VGM 0x04, or RA 0x08) to add, edit, or clear the caption (Description) on a kennel photo. Works on photos of any status. Passing NULL for @description explicitly clears the existing caption. The role check is performed against the photo's kennel, which is resolved via a lookup — no @kennelId parameter is required from the caller.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: UUID of the photo to update. If no KennelPhotos row exists with this ID, a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 1333, errorType 13).

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New caption text. NULL explicitly clears the existing caption. Empty string sets an empty caption (not the same as NULL). Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. On auth, validation, or role check failure: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On DB error: success=0, errorCode=1933, errorType=19. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: CaptionResult
rowsets.description: On success: the updated photoId and the new description value (which may be NULL if the caption was cleared). On error: standard HC6 error detail rowset. These two shapes are mutually exclusive at index 1.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The new caption value. NULL if @description was passed as NULL (caption cleared).

sideEffects: Updates KennelPhotos.Description and KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt for the photo.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on photo-not-found, role check failure, or unhandled DB error.

codeSmells.issue: Role mask 0x002E excludes WebMeister — inconsistent with hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus and hcapp_getRunAllPhotos
codeSmells.detail: This SP uses 0x002E (Hash Flash | GM | VGM | RA). hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus and hcapp_getRunAllPhotos use 0x102E which also includes WebMeister (0x1000). A WebMeister who can batch-approve photos cannot edit captions, which is likely an unintentional inconsistency.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
